answer: Clone keys cannot share a print-shop ticket. Each applicant receives one press-id bound to the live address and must wander the assigned aisle to a cold-type bench within 15 minutes. There they hand-set a 12-word fable whose checksum equals blake2b(addr||press_id||slug_serial) and lock a serialized ivory inlay into the chase. Fee is 0.34 POA, with a 19 POA bond held for 12 epochs. Inspectors re-set the type, recompute the checksum, and match the inlay serial to the ticket ledger. A reused press-id, swapped type, or a second inlay under another key seizes the bond and voids both tickets.
